info.title: Document Extraction API
info.description: Document classification and typed extraction with source evidence. Back Office owns requirements, cross-document checks, review decisions and protocols. Auth: header x-api-key when EXTRACTOR_API_KEY is set. See docs/API.md.

get.description:
Mint short-lived creds so the browser can SigV4-POST to the Function URL.

Needed because the org blocks AuthType NONE and CloudFront OAC breaks POST body signing.
Requires x-api-key. Credentials last 15 minutes and can only invoke this function.

post.description: Discover document types per page from the supplied catalog; no attribute extraction.

schema.title: Response Classify Json Classify Json Post

post.description: Extract one logical document using an explicit type and complete canonical/draft schemas.

schema.title: Response Extract Typed Json Extract Typed Json Post

post.description: Compare cited extracted facts; no business rules, tolerances or decisions.

contract_version.title: Contract Version
contract_version.description: Explicit opt-in to the evidence contract; never inferred by the provider.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Human-readable reason (422 from FastAPI validation is a list)

source_file.title: Source File
source_file.description: Filename in this response's immutable source-page manifest.

page.title: Page
page.description: Physical page number in the original source, never a printed or regrouped page number.

bounding_box.title: Bounding Box
bounding_box.description: Normalized [left, top, right, bottom] on the rendered page after the recorded rotation; null means page-level evidence only.

contract_version.title: Contract Version
contract_version.description: Explicit evidence contract version; never inferred or silently downgraded.

reader_mode.title: Reader Mode
reader_mode.description: Requested reading strategy, not a business acceptance policy.

page_selection.title: Page Selection
page_selection.description: Ordered physical pages forming one logical document in the supplied original file; null selects all pages. Original page numbers must survive extraction.

rotation_degrees.title: Rotation Degrees
rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation used for the upright evidence coordinates.

normalization_version.title: Normalization Version
normalization_version.description: Version of extraction normalization, independent of any Back Office business policy.

evidence_complete.title: Evidence Complete
evidence_complete.description: True only when every non-null attribute leaf except document_type has field evidence; not extraction accuracy or document completeness.

pointer.title: Pointer
pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into attributes, including array indices; bound to this extraction revision.

selected_reader_id.title: Selected Reader Id
selected_reader_id.description: Reader supplying the draft attribute; null when unresolved. Selection is not acceptance.

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.description: Exact agreement of normalized candidates within this document; no business tolerance or review status.

printed_page_number.title: Printed Page Number
printed_page_number.description: Page number printed on the document; distinct from physical source page.

printed_page_count.title: Printed Page Count
printed_page_count.description: Total page count printed on the source, not an assertion that all pages were received.

rotation_degrees.title: Rotation Degrees
rotation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation applied to the source page to obtain the upright evidence coordinate space.

group_hint.title: Group Hint
group_hint.description: Source-local grouping observation; Back Office decides document membership and ownership.

boundary.title: Boundary
boundary.description: Observed document boundary; unknown requires grouping resolution by Back Office.

model.title: Model
model.description: Actual provider/model version used for this operation.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Provider-reported input tokens; null when unavailable.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Provider-reported output tokens; null when unavailable.

duration_ms.title: Duration Ms
duration_ms.description: Measured provider duration in milliseconds; null when unavailable.

reader_id.title: Reader Id
reader_id.description: Unique reader identifier within this field, such as textract or vision.

model.title: Model
model.description: Actual reader model/version; not a reviewer identity.

value.description: Reader's normalized extraction candidate; null means unreadable or absent.

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: Reader's source transcription when available; no business interpretation.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Provider-reported extraction confidence for this reading; null if unavailable, never a classification score.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Source locations supporting this reader's candidate.
